entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought. This is taking forever and it's completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-8675309! I bought this thing ages ago, but the box is still unopened. I just want my money back.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the AeroSafe helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference? The color is completely wrong! I ordered shadow black and this thing is some kind of light gray. How am I supposed to trust my safety on the road to a company that can't even get a simple color right? This is ridiculous!
I certainly understand your frustration with the color not being what you expected. My apologies for that mix-up. Let me just review the return eligibility for you.

Review it? What's there to review?! The box is unopened! Process the return right now or get me your manager. I'm a VIP member and I swear I will post reviews about this everywhere if you give me the runaround!

That won't be necessary, sir. I appreciate your patience. I've just checked our policy, and I can see you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you immediately.
So you're just going to do it? No more hassle?

Yes, of course. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label to send to your email on file right now. And for the trouble with the helmet color and the inconvenience this has caused you as a valued VIP member, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for a future purchase.
Hmph. A credit, huh? Fine. That's better. Just make sure that email actually shows up.
I've just sent it, you should receive it within the next two minutes. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. We appreciate your business. Have a great day.
